# Needed.Men

> Practical editorial guides to men’s everyday carry, travel, work tools and modern essentials.

This site publishes buying guides and product recommendations. Some links are affiliate links; see the affiliate disclosure page.

## Pages
- [25 Everyday Carry Essentials for Modern Men | Needed.Men](https://needed.men/blog/everyday-carry-guide.html): A practical guide to 25 everyday carry categories for men, with selection criteria, limitations and organization advice.
- [Needed.Men | Modern Men’s Essentials, EDC, Travel & Work](https://needed.men/): Practical editorial guides to men’s everyday carry, travel, work tools and modern essentials.
